verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents an official MCP server that lets an AI assistant understand the customer schema, build audiences, and create and manage syncs. Its example prompt creates a cart-abandoner audience and a sync to Braze, which is audience creation through activation without the dashboard. A public REST API with a published OpenAPI spec also covers syncs, models, sources and destinations, and keys can be scoped for AI tools. missing for 10: explicit documentation that agents can query row-level customer data (beyond schema understanding and performance analysis), audience endpoints in the REST API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end agent workflows.
